info.title: VitalSense API
info.description: Health monitoring platform API — real-time gait analysis, fall risk detection, balance assessment, and health data processing. Powered by Cloudflare Workers.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Analytics configuration versions (gait, fall risk). ETag-cacheable.

tags.name: Live Health Data
tags.description: Real-time gait and balance data ingestion with WebSocket broadcast.

tags.name: Health Data Processing
tags.description: Process, enrich, and store health metrics with analytics scoring.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: 2FA management, user export, device JWT issuance.

tags.name: WebSocket
tags.description: Real-time bidirectional streaming for health data and alerts.

tags.name: Telemetry
tags.description: Client-side error reporting, RUM performance metrics, and WebSocket lifecycle telemetry.

ETag.description: Config version ETag for conditional requests

200.description: Current fall risk config and version
Gait + fall risk config versions (single round-trip)

post.description: Submit a single gait measurement. Broadcasts to connected WebSocket clients. Rate limit: 120 req/min.
Submit up to 50 gait measurements in one request. Rate limit: 30 req/min.

get.summary: Recent gait snapshots with rolling statistics

200.description: Recent snapshots with rolling averages and trend analysis

post.description: Submit real-time balance test progress. Broadcasts to WebSocket clients. Rate limit: 120 req/min.
Final balance test result. Rate limit: 30 req/min.

200.description: Recent balance results and last progress

post.description: Validates, enriches with analytics (health score, fall risk, trend), encrypts, and stores in KV. Rate limit: 60 req/min.

post.summary: Process a batch of health metrics
post.description: Process up to 100 metrics in one request. Rate limit: 20 req/min.

get.description: Download a JSON export of server-held user data (GDPR-compliant).

post.description: Exchange device credentials for a short-lived HS256 JWT.

get.summary: WebSocket upgrade for real-time health data
get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket for live gait/balance streaming and alerts. Without `Upgrade: websocket` header, returns metadata.

post.description: Submit client errors for analytics and audit logging. Returns a correlationId for tracing.
Submit client-side WebSocket telemetry (connections, disconnects, errors, latency).
Submit anonymized Real User Monitoring metrics (LCP, TTFB, hydration, CLS, INP). Rate limit: 30 req/min per IP.

metrics.description: RUM metrics — only valid keys are: lcp, ttfb, hydration, wsConnect, cls, inp

400.description: No valid metrics or invalid payload

get.description: Returns the WebSocket URL for the current environment.

get.summary: Check if live WebSocket streaming is enabled

bearerAuth.description: Auth0 JWT. Obtain via Auth0 login flow or POST /api/device/auth for device tokens.

source.description: Data source (e.g. Apple Watch, manual entry)

correlatedMetrics.description: Related metrics that influenced this reading
